name: Pyromancer Scorching Spirit and Flamer scale Spirit and cast speed (#3534, #1954)
contract: #3534 Scorching Spirit 805552 (+10%) and 807935 (+20%): one APPLY_AURA 137 (MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE) with MiscValue 4 (Spirit), handled by HandleModTotalPercentStat, so the character-sheet Spirit rises by that factor. #1954 Flamer 680836 (+4%) and 520546 (+8%): one APPLY_AURA 216 (HASTE_SPELLS) handled by HandleModCastingSpeed, which scales the unit's cast-time multiplier by 100/104 and 100/108. The two ranks are asserted on separate players because the ranks are not meant to stack. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively: the asserted quantities are ratios to a snapshot taken on the same player before it learns the passives.
